title: Kirby Problem 3.54
exact_target: Can torsion occur in canonical integral hat Floer homology of a closed three-manifold, of a rational homology sphere, or of a knot in the three-sphere?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2852 (KP-3.54). CC BY 4.0.
